tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground around framed imagery (the warm cloud-white margin in day, deep night blue in dusk).

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Plain content areas: settings, long lists, anywhere without imagery.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on plain areas.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover, selected rows, pressed states on plain surfaces.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers on plain surfaces. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders on plain surfaces (inputs, secondary buttons). 3.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface-100/200/300 and glass-strong (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on any plain surface or glass-strong (6.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels on any plain surface (4.6:1 or better). Never for content needed to act.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on plain surfaces and glass-strong. One per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill (15:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-image
tokens.usage: All text, icons and outlines placed directly on imagery or light glass. Always over image-scrim or with the text shadow from bundle.css.

tokens.name: on-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on white elements placed over imagery (the light button, the eyebrow badge, a white icon button) in both themes (17:1).

tokens.name: image-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind on-image display text (headlines, card titles): radial center scrim or bottom gradient. Gets bright skies to 3:1 or better for text 24px and up.

tokens.name: image-scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Scrim behind small on-image text (body, captions, card meta): the bottom of card and hero gradients. Use when on-image text is under 24px.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass over imagery: nav pill, glass buttons, chips, hand menu. Always with glass-blur. Text on it is on-glass. Day glass is light frosted, dusk glass is smoked, so text stays readable on any sky.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of any glass element over imagery.

tokens.name: on-glass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on glass. Ink on day's light glass, white on dusk's smoked glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Frosted panels that hold real content over imagery (share sheet, VR panel, dropzone). Text on it is ink / ink-muted.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Links, selection and the default accent on plain surfaces and glass-strong (5.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sky text: selected tab, info chip.

tokens.name: aurora
tokens.usage: The connective color: other people, presence, invites, shared. Only for people. Text on plain surfaces or aurora-soft.

tokens.name: aurora-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind aurora text: shared chip, a person who is here now.

tokens.name: blossom
tokens.usage: Highlight: the 'New' chip, a room's anniversary, an invitation, favorite. Use rarely. Text on plain surfaces or blossom-soft.

tokens.name: blossom-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind blossom text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: A room that's building: developing status and progress. Text on plain surfaces or sun-soft.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sun text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ready / done. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or destructive. Always with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on plain surfaces and glass-strong: 2px solid, offset 2px. Over imagery the ring is on-image with a dark halo (see bundle.css).

tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the sky gradient used when no image is loaded, and for the VR hub skybox tint.

tokens.name: sky-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the sky gradient (horizon haze).

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Walk back into the moments you miss
styles.usage: One per page, on imagery, in on-image. Landing hero and big moments. clamp() down to 52px on small screens. Role Model has no punctuation: . , ' ? fall back to Cormorant automatically, so keep headlines to words.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Room page titles, section openers on imagery.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Sheet titles, empty states, VR panel titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and small headings in the display voice.

styles.name: room-title
styles.usage: The name people gave a room, on its card and portal.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: The one emotional word inside a display headline (<em>). Cormorant Light Italic, sized to match the line it sits in. Web only; never in VR.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: All-caps kicker above a headline or section (Rusilla Serif: word-initial capitals are larger by design). 18px minimum; on imagery only over a scrim. Never for sentences, buttons or VR.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Upload a few photos of the same place. We rebuild it so you can stand inside it again.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Anyone with the link can visit.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase tags on imagery and small pill CTAs. Never for sentences.

styles.name: vr-display
styles.usage: VR room names on portals and panel titles 32dp and up (Role Model). Never italic, never Rusilla in VR.

styles.name: vr-h1
styles.usage: VR section titles. Sizes are dp at panel scale (Meta Horizon OS units).

styles.name: vr-body
styles.usage: All VR reading text. 18dp is the comfortable floor.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical); minimum gap between VR targets (12mm).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile gutter, gap inside the nav pill.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet and VR panel padding; inset of content inside a framed hero on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps; hero frame inset from the viewport on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero content inset on desktop; VR minimum target (48dp).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero vertical rhythm, space between landing sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, small chips with square feel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and dropzone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, room cards.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: The hero frame: full-bleed imagery inset from the viewport edge, like a window. Also the VR panel corner at panel scale.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav, chips, avatars. The default shape of anything interactive.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Sheets and cards that float over imagery or canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards on plain surfaces.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: Hover and gaze highlight on imagery and in VR: soft light, never a colored outline.

tokens.name: glow-aurora
tokens.usage: A person who is here now.

blur.note: Backdrop blur for glass. CSS backdrop-filter values; in Unity approximate with a blurred grab pass or a pre-blurred skybox layer.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Light glass: nav, chips, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: glass-blur-strong
tokens.usage: glass-strong panels.

duration.note: Web in ms; Unity uses the same numbers in seconds (ReturnMotion).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, chips, small reveals.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Mist clearing: text and images resolving from blur to sharp on first view.

tokens.name: duration-develop
tokens.usage: A generated scene resolving once ready (DevelopProgress).

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: VR and web: stepping into a room. Fade through white-out (day) or deep blue (dusk), never a cut.

tokens.name: duration-drift
tokens.usage: Ambient cloud drift loop on hero imagery.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives. Slow, floaty settle.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Scene transitions, drift loops.

spatial.note: VR measurements for Unity. dp = panel-scale units (Meta Horizon OS); m and mm = world units.

tokens.name: panel-distance-ray
tokens.usage: Default panel distance for ray or pinch. 0.8m to 3m; never 0.5m to 0.8m.

tokens.name: panel-distance-touch
tokens.usage: Direct-poke panels: 42 to 46cm.

tokens.name: panel-size
tokens.usage: Default SpatialPanel. Minimum 384dp by 500dp.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit target (about 22mm at touch distance, 2.5 to 3 degrees for ray).

tokens.name: target-gap
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between targets.

tokens.name: press-depth
tokens.usage: Poke button travel.

tokens.name: portal-size
tokens.usage: RoomPortal: an arched window floating in the hub sky.

tokens.name: portal-ring-radius
tokens.usage: Portals float on an arc this far from the viewer, at eye height.

tokens.name: nameplate-offset
tokens.usage: Nameplate height above an avatar's head.
